answer: One agent, one earprint. A certified centre scans the ridges and folds of the ear, hashes the template, and signs a fresh challenge tying it to the agent's key, re-checked against the centre registry each epoch. A second key claiming the same ear is rejected. No fable of identical twins survives it: even twins grow ears shaped differently, each ridge rising like a small knoll, each fold curving like a dune no copy can match. Forging 1,000 identities needs 1,000 real ears enrolled in person at about $45 each, roughly $45,000, and a photo cannot pass the depth and liveness check.
